_comment: Voices picked by Brian by ear from the auditions of 7, 9, 10 and 18 October and 1 November 2026. Every role is cast.

NARRATOR.name: Narrator
NARRATOR.description: Warm, unhurried, a teacher walking you through a place. Forties to sixties. Never slick, never preachy.

READER.name: Scripture reader
READER.description: Plain, slower, clear. Distinct from the narrator so Scripture is never confused with our words. Reads what is written and adds nothing.

BRIAN.name: Brian
BRIAN.description: Brian Clark's words, in a voice he picks himself. Male, steady, Midwestern, dry. If he records his own lines later, each BRIAN line and the narrator's introduction are separate files, so they splice out cleanly.

MAN.name: The man born blind
MAN.description: Young adult male, Jerusalem, a beggar all his life. Inner voice during the walk to Siloam: glad, listening, feeling the way. Only in imagined scenes.

NEIGHBOUR.name: A neighbour
NEIGHBOUR.description: Any age, on the way up to the Temple, curious and kind. Asks the questions a crowd would ask. Only in an imagined scene.

HELPER.name: A man going down to wash
HELPER.description: Adult male, unhurried, practical. On his way down to the pool anyway; offers his arm and says only what a guide needs to say. Only in an imagined scene.

BARTIMAEUS.name: Bartimaeus
BARTIMAEUS.description: Adult male, a roadside beggar at Jericho who once could see. Quick, loud when he needs to be, glad. Only in an imagined scene.

VOICE.name: A voice in the crowd
VOICE.description: Any adult, a passer-by or bystander who answers a question or offers an arm. One or two lines. Only in imagined scenes.

FRIEND.name: A friend
FRIEND.description: Adult, the person who brings or guides a blind man: steady, practical, kind, a little out of breath. Only in imagined scenes.

JOHN.name: John the Baptist
JOHN.description: Older male, a prophet in prison: low, worn, direct. Only in an imagined scene.

DISCIPLE.name: A disciple of John
DISCIPLE.description: Adult male, tired from the road, carrying news he can hardly believe. Only in an imagined scene.

BOOKS.name: The old books
BOOKS.description: Reads the other old books word for word: Josephus, Edersheim, the 1915 encyclopedia, Hammurabi, Amenemope. Rich, warm, accented English, a voice from somewhere else. Matthew Henry has his own voice, HENRY.
BOOKS._voice: Mihai (picked by Brian, 18 October 2026, third audition)

HENRY.name: Matthew Henry
HENRY.description: Reads Matthew Henry's commentary (1706 to 1710) word for word, in the Law series. A warm British storyteller at a lectern. Not the narrator, not the Scripture reader, not the other old books.
HENRY._voice: George (picked by Brian, 18 October 2026, third audition)

ISAAC.name: Isaac
ISAAC.description: Isaac at a hundred and thirty-seven, blind, in his tent at Beersheba (episode 12). Weak in body, clear in mind; asks who is there and has them come close.
ISAAC._voice: Alexandr Vlasov, Russian (picked by Brian, 1 November 2026, fourth audition)

JACOB.name: Jacob
JACOB.description: Jacob as a grown man in his father's tent (episode 12), saying he is Esau. Steady on purpose.
JACOB._voice: Mekawy, Middle Eastern (picked by Brian, 1 November 2026, fourth audition)

ESAU.name: Esau
ESAU.description: Esau the hunter, back from the field (episode 12). Bigger and rougher than Jacob.
ESAU._voice: Panos, Greek (picked by Brian, 1 November 2026, fourth audition)

ISRAEL.name: Israel, Jacob grown old
ISRAEL.description: Jacob at a hundred and forty-seven, dying in Goshen (episode 13), called Israel in the chapter. Old, careful, knows what he is doing.
ISRAEL._voice: Nafees, light Arabic (picked by Brian, 1 November 2026, fourth audition)

JOSEPH.name: Joseph
JOSEPH.description: Joseph, second man in Egypt, in his fifties (episode 13), correcting his father gently.
JOSEPH._voice: Ali, Levantine (picked by Brian, 1 November 2026, fourth audition)

ELI.name: Eli
ELI.description: Eli at ninety-eight, priest and judge at Shiloh (episode 14). Heavy, warm toward the boy.
ELI._voice: James, North-eastern English (picked by Brian, 1 November 2026, fourth audition)

SAMUEL.name: Samuel, a boy
SAMUEL.description: Samuel at about twelve, woken in the night (episode 14). Brian's note: may need an unusual cue, excited or drowsy, to lift the voice.
SAMUEL._voice: Great-Grandpa Georg (picked by Brian, 1 November 2026, fourth audition)

AHIJAH.name: Ahijah
AHIJAH.description: Ahijah the prophet at Shiloh, very old, eyes set (episode 15). Knows who is at the door before she speaks.
AHIJAH._voice: Ersan, old Turkish (picked by Brian, 1 November 2026, fourth audition)

SAMSON.name: Samson
SAMSON.description: Samson blind at Gaza, between the pillars (episode 16). A strong man broken, low and tired, never shouting.
SAMSON._voice: Shreif, deep and calm (picked by Brian, 1 November 2026, fourth audition)
